'''Layek Davos''' was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He fought in the Imperial victory at the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was still stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] and tried with all means to achieve a promotion.<ref name="Frigid Expedition" /> During the Cold War, while serving as the commander of [[Imperial Search and Recovery]], along with few trusted men such as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leo Furth]], he made an alliance with the [[Marauders (White Maw)|Marauders]] group of the [[White Maw]] pirates and attempted to seize the prized [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Starbreeze]]'' from the hangar bay of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]]. However, [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Raina Temple]] interrupted their attempts and in the ensuing firefight both Davos and Furth were killed.<ref name="Assault on the Starbreeze" />
